invariants.EF-TX-001: Terminal execution states cannot leave terminality.
invariants.EF-TX-002: Provider execution is requested only after authorization and durable STARTED intent.
invariants.EF-TX-003: An ambiguous provider outcome is represented as UNKNOWN rather than assumed failure.
invariants.EF-TX-004: UNKNOWN cannot return to PREPARED until reconciliation proves NOT_HAPPENED.
invariants.EF-TX-005: Orphan recovery advances fencing before the recovered action becomes UNKNOWN.
invariants.EF-TX-006: A provider receipt can only be committed from STARTED or UNKNOWN.
invariants.EF-TX-007: A pending withdrawal/supersession may close UNKNOWN as EXECUTION_FAILED only after authoritative NOT_HAPPENED settlement.
